text:
Erik Haula, 35, is in his first season with the Kings, his eighth NHL franchise, and his scoring looks like what he is: an honest middle-six forward. He has 4 goals and 9 points in 22 games at 15:32 a night, and the goals match his chances (3.8 expected goals, shooting a normal 13%). The one-timer still works. NHL.com's headline after his tying goal in Toronto on Nov. 19 said he drilled it, and his top shot speed ranks in the 91st percentile. He also had 6 points in 6 games for Finland at the 2026 Olympics.

The worry is the other end. Los Angeles gets only about 40% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him on the ice, 12 points worse than when he sits. That fits last season, when Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level, costing 3.6 goals in penalties and allowing 0.14 more expected goals per 60 than a typical forward. He adds 46 hits. Our numbers project about 36 points; the minutes may depend on that chance share.
headline: Erik Haula settles in on his eighth NHL team
